newsitem.title: UK: GKN bruised by strong pound, rate outlook.
newsitem.headline: GKN bruised by strong pound, rate outlook.

text.p: Shares in leading engineering stocks were led down by GKN which fell sharply on the persistent strength of sterling and the outlook for near-term interest rate rises, dealers said on Friday.
GKN fell 28-1/2p to 930-1/2p after falling almost 50p on Thursday. TI Group was another casualty, losing 24p to 458p coming after a 32-1/2p fall yesterday.
Overseas earners were shaken by the rampant pound, which was trading around six year highs after the Labour government's first budget was seen doing little to dampen the currency's continuing rally.
"All the engineers are weak because of sterling and the prospect of interest rate rises," said one dealer.
The growing expectation that domestic interest rates were set to rise sharply in the coming months was seen sending sterling even higher, dealers said.
